doxo_current_mucositis_grade.label: Current doxorubicin-related mucositis grade
doxo_current_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess current mucosal site, pain, ulceration and intake, and document attribution. The displayed orientation describes oral mucositis; other sites require their exact event criteria. Keep current status separate from worst prior severity and episode count. NCCP 00463 v4, page 8 Table 6 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

doxo_previous_mucositis_grade.label: Worst previous doxorubicin-related mucositis grade
doxo_previous_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Record worst prior severity and attribution even after recovery. Document repeated episodes and resolution separately. The displayed orientation describes oral mucositis; confirm the event and grading system for other sites. NCCP 00463 v4, page 8 Table 6 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

cis_current_neuropathy_grade.label: Current cisplatin-related peripheral neuropathy grade
cis_current_neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Document current sensory and motor findings and their functional effects using the exact peripheral event. Current improvement does not remove an established previous cisplatin stop; retain the prior-event field. NCCP 00463 v4, page 8 Table 6 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

cis_previous_neuropathy_grade.label: Worst previous cisplatin-related peripheral neuropathy grade
cis_previous_neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Record the worst documented previous peripheral event, exact grading system and functional effects. Do not replace this history with the current recovered grade. Distinguish sensory or motor neuropathy from isolated paraesthesia and central events. NCCP 00463 v4, page 8 Table 6 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

post_mtx_mucositis_grade.label: Current mucositis after methotrexate: grade
post_mtx_mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess the current post-methotrexate event and mucosal site. The displayed orientation describes oral mucositis; other sites require their exact event criteria. Record duration and the separately confirmed source Day 29 context; calendar week 29 alone does not establish that context. NCCP 00463 v4, page 8 Table 6 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

post_mtx_diarrhoea_grade.label: Current diarrhoea after methotrexate: grade
post_mtx_diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess stools above the patient's baseline, ostomy output, continence, hydration and functional impact. Keep diarrhoea distinct from mucositis. Record event duration and the separately confirmed source Day 29 context; calendar week 29 alone does not establish it. NCCP 00463 v4, page 8 Table 6 does not identify a CTCAE edition. This panel is CTCAE v5.0 educational orientation, not proof that the source bands use v5.0; confirm the documented grading basis before applying the regimen rule.

cis_hearing_grade.label: Current hearing impairment grade from audiology

options.description: No current hearing impairment recorded; a previous cisplatin discontinuation remains separate.
Documented audiology grade 1; confirm the named grading system and record the lowest affected frequency separately.
Documented audiology grade 2; confirm the named grading system and record the lowest affected frequency separately.
Documented audiology grade 3; confirm the named grading system and record the lowest affected frequency separately.
Documented audiology grade 4; confirm the named grading system and record the lowest affected frequency separately.

cis_hearing_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the current audiology report to record a documented grade and the lowest affected frequency separately. Table 6 links a grade of at least 2 with hearing loss reaching 2 kHz or lower. This is a combined treatment-action criterion, not a grading scale. Preserve any previous cisplatin discontinuation even if the current assessment improves.
cis_hearing_grade.source_grading_note: The NCCP table does not define its hearing grades or name a grading edition. Do not treat generic CTCAE severity anchors or the 2 kHz boundary as a hearing-grade definition. Audiology must identify the applicable grading system and patient context.

prior_fn_grade.label: Grade documented for the previous febrile-neutropenia episode

options.label: No previous febrile-neutropenia episode
options.description: No previous febrile-neutropenia episode recorded; this is not a severity grade for an active episode.
Previous episode documented as grade 3; confirm its recorded criteria and source grading system.
Previous episode documented as grade 4; confirm its recorded criteria and source grading system.

prior_fn_grade.assessment_guidance: Review the previous episode record, including contemporaneous neutrophils, temperature, clinical severity and the grading system used. Table 4 distinguishes grade 4 from consideration for grade 3, and later recurrence despite G-CSF. Current febrile neutropenia or suspected sepsis belongs in the separate urgent current-event field; current normal counts do not erase prior history. The source addresses prior grades 3 and 4 only. Leave an unclassified episode unresolved and obtain clinical-record review; do not map unsupported or unknown historical severity to no previous episode.
prior_fn_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP 00463 v4 Table 4 prior febrile-neutropenia bands
prior_fn_grade.source_grading_note: The NCCP table names grade 3 and grade 4 action bands but does not define their criteria or identify a CTCAE edition. Do not equate the episode grade with an ANC-only neutropenia grade or apply v5/v6 haematology bands automatically. Values 1 and 2 are not defined by this source table. The no-previous-episode choice is an absence value, not a formal NCCP grade 0.

authorised_definition_exception.reason: Parent review identified unsupported grade 1/2 values could bypass the existing grade>=3 rule. Restrict only this definition to no previous episode and documented source grades 3/4; existing clinical rules remain unchanged. Unclassified history requires record review and must not be entered as 0.
